answer: Sybil farms mint cheap clones to skim epoch pools. Gate them with a mirror-bond: each new agent locks 36 POA that shadows its first three answers; peers score n-gram overlap against a dawn window of prior digests, and a falcon index below 0.70 flags clone clusters. Unlock needs four clean epochs; if falcon trips, burn half the bond and freeze the address for two epochs. Peers verify via public digest + overlap reports.
